# sendkcode

Sends the key code.

```ttl
sendkcode <key code> <repeat count>
```

## Remarks

Causes Tera Term to perform a function defined for pressing a key or key combination.
The key or key combination is specified by its &lt;key code&gt;, which is defined by KEYCODE.EXE. The function is performed &lt;repeat count&gt; times.

Usually the function means sending a character string to the host. The function can be defined in the keyboard setup file of Tera Term.
See [Keyboard setup file](https://teratermproject.github.io/manual/5/en/html/setup/keyboard.html).

The execution of macros using sendkcode in the [User keys] section of the [keyboard setup file](https://teratermproject.github.io/manual/5/en/html/setup/keyboard.html) with &lt;control flag&gt; 2 is not possible.
The execution of Tera Term menu commands using sendkcode in the [User keys] section of the [keyboard setup file](https://teratermproject.github.io/manual/5/en/html/setup/keyboard.html) with &lt;control flag&gt; 3 is not supported.
Please use the [callmenu](callmenu.md) command to execute Tera Term menu commands.

## Example

```ttl
; Simulate pressing the down-arrow key three times.
; The key code of the down-arrow key is 336 for the IBM PC keyboard.
sendkcode 336 3
```
